lessons.note: For diagnostic/doctor-style commands that need non-standard exit codes (e.g. 101), call os.Exit() directly inside the function rather than returning an error — the main error handler always exits 1, which would violate the semantic exit code contract.
`gh auth status` exits 0 when authenticated and non-zero otherwise; suppress stdout/stderr with cmd.Stdout = nil / cmd.Stderr = nil to keep doctor output clean.
